entities.summary: Freddy Mamani Silvestre is a Bolivian self-taught architect noted for his development of the Neo-Andean architectural style. His work is most associated with the city of El Alto and with the new social class of upwardly mobile indigenous Bolivians. Freddy Mamani was a architects & engineers from Catavi (b. 1971-11-01, Catavi). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
